basis.publicValue: 004-A produces a usable source register, claim queue and status-derived brief without accounts, prompts or specialist vocabulary; interaction changes which claims can enter findings.
basis.technologicalCeiling: A deterministic local workflow is intentionally stronger for this build's premise than adding automated retrieval or model synthesis before the human method is defined. Rejected complexity is recorded in docs/builds/004-release-record.md.
basis.evidenceProvenance: Product behavior is governed by the canonical registry definition and build-004-engine-v1 invariants; the build makes no external factual claim that drives scoring or truth determination.
basis.verificationEvaluation: Adversarial Playwright fixtures cover unverified, verified, contradicted, source-deletion and new-claim states; final branch CI remains required after all release files land.
basis.browserFallback: Core path uses standard browser HTML/JS and no experimental browser or AI API.
basis.stateExportShare: Current state is visible in source/claim cards and brief buckets; explicit JSON export preserves full research state; no implicit sharing path exists.
basis.publicRecord: 004 is present in the shared public record with making, method, evidence and limits, and its artifact/release support files are recorded.
basis.lineage: docs/infrastructure-manifest.json records exact Exhibition Room Shell reuse and the durable Manual Intelligence Engine Method v1 artifact.
basis.metadata: The canonical object route has unique generated metadata; 004-A and 004-B have distinct titles, descriptions, canonical routes, OG and Twitter metadata; 004 is activated as ON VIEW rather than PLANNED.
